_comment: Mirror of the package definitions configured in PracticeQ (Bookings > Booking Settings > Services > Packages). Keys must match the exact package Name, which comes back as AppointmentPackageName on appointments and appears in invoice line-item Descriptions. valid_days null = no expiry. expiry_basis is 'booking' or 'appointment' to match the package's Expiration Window setting. count_as_used includes Canceled because PracticeQ does not replenish a canceled package appointment unless staff add the slot back; remove it if your staff always re-add slots.
